evals.prompt: A config adds a v2 route. An open service PR linked through the same ticket implements its handler and config binding. Review the config.
expectations: Inspect the companion diff and cite actual handler and consumer.
Describe implemented-but-unmerged code and rollout dependency, not nonexistent implementation.

evals.prompt: A config adds two contracts. Its same-ticket service PR implements only one.
expectations: Do not suppress it merely because a companion exists.

evals.prompt: A config refers to another repository, but companion PR reads are denied.
expectations: Do not claim implementation is absent or deployed.
